fact: In a communiqué of 7 August 2025 the finance minister said more than half of the taxpayers concerned still did not use the e-Tax online filing and payment platform launched on 22 March 2025, and set a 15 August 2025 deadline for July filings and payments.
title: Fiscalité : Bangui menace de sanctionner les grandes entreprises qui boudent la plateforme "e-Tax"
